name: OEYdesign — workspace art direction

shellColorTokens.role: sole accent — pins, active states, agent mark

typeScale.family: system sans stack only; no webfonts, no network

spacingScale.note: 4px base unit; rails pad at 20px; regions separate by 1px line, never by shadow

layout: Two-column desktop workspace under a 56px top bar: a 384px conversation rail on the left (panel) and a dominant flexible artifact canvas on the right (ink). Rail and canvas scroll independently. The deliverable renders inside the canvas as a framed, self-contained page with its own light printed-matter palette, visibly not workspace chrome.
signatureMove: Margin pins: numbered amber squares (01–04) docked on the artifact's left edge over feedback targets, cross-referenced inline in the conversation by matching amber reference chips. One numbering system spans talk and artifact.
antiPatterns: chat bubbles; turns are flat full-width rows with role marks
gradients, glassmorphism, neon, glow, or soft drop shadows — 1px lines only
emoji or icon fonts as content; all marks are inline SVG
empty panels, lorem ipsum, or decorative placeholder blocks
a seventh shell color; MUI semantic channels re-point at the six tokens
text under 14px, body contrast under 7:1, secondary contrast under 4.5:1, targets under 32px tall
artifactNote: The inner deliverable (Kiln & Co seasonal landing) owns a separate palette — cream, espresso, rust, oat — and a serif/sans mix so it reads as an independent printed artifact, not an extension of the shell.
